profile.headline: Data Science & Software Engineer | Boeing Defense and Space | Mission Systems
profile.summary:
📊 Data Science & Business Intelligence Leader | ✈️ Aviation Enthusiast | 🛠 Manufacturing Engineer | 🤝 Volunteer & Mentor

With over a decade dedicated to the aviation industry, I've honed my expertise at the intersection of data science, business intelligence, and engineering. At the heart of my professional journey lies a passion for transforming raw data into actionable insights, guiding teams to harness the power of data visualization and driving operational efficiency.

🔍 My tenure with The Boeing Company afforded me the opportunity to lead cutting-edge projects, from developing interactive dashboards to pioneering machine learning solutions for aircraft safety. As a Manufacturing Engineer and Aero structures Project Leader, I've navigated the complexities of aircraft production, ensuring quality and adherence to rigorous industry standards.

🌟 My experience isn't limited to the confines of the corporate world. I'm a staunch advocate for STEM education, mentoring the next generation of business intelligence professionals. Additionally, I contribute to the community, capturing moments as a photographer for charity events and championing community engagement activities.

Driven by innovation and a ceaseless pursuit of excellence, I continue to explore the evolving landscapes of data science, always eager to collaborate, innovate, and inspire.

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
Data Scientist focused on building analytics platforms for enterprise quality and compliance systems. Lead development of end-to-end data solutions supporting regulatory and audit operations, including data pipelines, statistical models, and executive dashboards.

Primary contributions include development of the Production Area Self-Assessment (PASA) analytics framework, enabling large-scale, standardized risk and compliance reporting across operational teams, and automation of Required Reading tracking and analytics to improve workforce compliance, audit readiness, and leadership visibility.

Specialize in Python-based systems (Flask, SQL, Pandas, NumPy), machine learning, and visualization (Tableau, React) to support auditors and leadership in risk detection, regulatory reporting, and data-driven decision-making.

positions.title: Senior Business Intelligence
positions.description:
Technical Initiatives Leader - Data Science and Analytics

Strategic Leadership: Pioneered technological strategies that elevated Boeing Core Quality's operational standards.

Dashboard Design & Implementation: Orchestrated the conceptualization and deployment of Aircraft Foreign Object Debris (FOD) dashboards, featuring a noteworthy executive-level 'Fod Per Tail' visualization.

Data Visualization Excellence: Masterfully harnessed Tableau to weave data into compelling narratives via interactive dashboards, fostering informed decision-making and bolstering operational prowess.

Team Leadership & Innovation: Captained a diverse team of data scientists and developers, breaking new ground with machine learning and computer vision technologies for instantaneous FOD detection - a critical step in averting potential aviation disasters.

Capacity Enhancement: Crafted a suite of training materials and videos, significantly elevating the team's expertise in dashboard utilization and specialized FOD data analysis.

Data-Driven Improvements: Steered the continuous analysis of FOD data, translating insights into actionable process enhancements and anchoring transformative workshops.

Technological Advancements: Delved deep into web-based frameworks like Flask and React, designing holistic data solutions that embraced varied data sources. Also helmed the launch of an FAA-compliant writing platform.

positions.title: Senior Operations Analyst (Business Intelligence)
positions.description:
Senior LSCC business Intelligence developer. Using SQL, Tableau, Python, C#, R to automate production metrics. 

Leader in culture change by scaling new systems and bringing structure to programs where non existed. Taking current systems and revamping them using agile methodology to drive change and improve performance, visibility, and ultimately touch time on product. Eliminate systemic issues across the enterprise using data and providing insite to leaders.

Programs include: VC-25B executive fleet, Vc-25A executive fleet, E4B, C17, F18, F15, B52, Apache, Chinook, and V22 helicopters. 737, 747, 767, Kc46, 777, and 787.

Leader of enterprise Business Intelligence team to bring technology and automation through the use of information technology to forever change the future.

positions.title: Lead Aircraft Technician
positions.description: Skills: English · Organizational Performance · SharePoint · Analytical Skills · Narrative · Program Planning

positions.title: Field Service Project Leader
positions.description:
Supporting large commercial and military aircraft reworking supplier parts to meet engineering specifications. Support Heavy Structures and Avionics/Electrical.

Largest project so far is Teardown of Alenia/Leonardo Vertical fin torque boxes and reworking parts to new type design to meet a safe Aviation Specification.
positions.insights: Skills: English · Organizational Performance · Narrative · Program Planning

positions.title: Aviation Maintenance Technician
positions.description:
Systems/Flight Controls mechanic supporting rework on Boeing 737 (NGs and Classics) Aircraft as well as Airbus A330-200 series.

Supported Mostly Westjet and Alaska Airlines however would support Southwest and Hawaiin Airlines on occasion.

Receive and Marshal live aircraft, Check fluids of Engines, Check for wear on tires and PSI levels, and ultimately access and inspect for corrosion and fatigue. Alaska Airlines typically was installing winglets and heavy modification of wing structures. After modifications were complete I would rig ailerons as necessary.

positions.title: Continuous Improvement Coordinator
positions.description:
Process engineering. Analyze value stream and map with VSM, Sphaghetti Chart, Process Flowcharts, SIPOC diagram, FMEA, CTQs, Stakeholder Analysis, Cause and Effect Matric, Root Cause Analysis and finally DMAIC Work Breakdown Structures.

Key to this was understanding DMAIC but ultimately identifying wasteful processes and come up with ways to mitigate their effects or eliminate them completely as well as provide engineering level support to shop floor personal for tools and ergonomic work flow.
positions.insights: Skills: English · Organizational Performance · Research · Narrative

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
Boeing F.A.S.T (Fabrication, Assembly, Setup and Test)

Estimate Hours, Analyze, Manage Deliverables and Project Management, and break expensive stuff in the name of science!

Support Kite lighting lab for KC46
Supported flight test engineering for aerodymnic shapes on military test aircraft.
Developed Manufacturing Plans and ROM estimates for bidding of contracts and developing schedules of manufacturing work flow and capacity management.
Supported AGM-84 Harpoon Missile test stand fabrication. Developed ROM Estimates and Build Plans to flight test Harpoon Missiles in a lab environment.
Supported Wet Fuel Lab and 2-10 Machine Shop producing full scale mockup of KC46 fuel tank for pressure testing for fuel boom delivery system.
Developed Build Plan for KC46 Kite Testing Electrical Racks
Developed Build Plan for KC46 Bird Strike test on windshield test articles.
Liason Shipside Support Manufacturing Engineer for 787 Fatigue Test and barge expert.
Served as Backup for P8 Poseidon Fatigue testing.
Developed planning for 737 Lavatory Intrusion Testing, built battering ram to simulate intrusion.
Worked with Machine shop on 777X Folding wing development and testing. Created Labor Estimates and potential material costs.

Estimate labor hours for capacity planning on projects for machine shop and mechanics/welders. Work closely with SCA to analyze best source of parts in accordance with company contracts. Decide if parts are a make/buy decision based on capacity, schedule and cost analysis. Obtain quotes from contracted vendors for raw material and parts shipments. When parts recieved, generate manufacturing build plan per aerospace standard and generate statement of work for supporting shops, or contract and offload work statement if capability of shop is exceeded. Work as surveillance on contracted vendors to ensure processes are met per plan. Work with FAA on delivering testing data by ensuring conformity information is achieved per build plans we wrote.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Worked as project manager in addition to being lead mechanic on lean projects arround shop.

Managed crew of Lean Professionals, Database Analysts, IT Professionals and Engineers to develop software that auto generates forms based on a Data Matrix barcode and with the support of leadership began implementing onto shop floor. ROI on this project is $45,000,000 annually for 787 line alone.

positions.title: 787 Manufacturing Technician Lead
positions.description:
Team lead for 787 Dreamliner: Wing Flight Control systems, Propulsion Systems, Landing Gear, External Fairings, Wheel Well, Fuselage Heavy Structures, Flight Deck, Galleys, Cargo and Cargo handling. 

Held crew accountable based on measured data and schedule. Developed recovery plans with industrial engineering to meet dates and avoid schedule slides using project management techniques and critical path analysis. Developed and deployed lean tools on prototype aircraft production systems to improve on tact time to allow customers to receive aircraft when they needed. Create flow based on lean manufacturing principles to reduce waste in work area.

positions.title: Manufacturing Manager
positions.description:
787 HSTAB Teardown Partner Warranty Rework and reassembly. 
787 48 Section and APU Electrical Systems, Vertical Fin Actuators and Flight Control Systems
Mentored leaders in Boeing values and leadership attributes.
Supervised Global Partners (Alenia and Planetech as partner warranty) and ensured Boeing Standards, Customer Contracts, and Government Regulations were held without sacrificing quality or delivery metrics.
Took action on unsatisfactory metrics and improved on them with QMS standards.

positions.title: 787 Manufacturing Technician
positions.description: Assemble and install components on 787 Dream liner aircraft. This included large scale projects such as side of body modifications, bracket modifications, Current Return Network installation and modifications, waterjet composite door modifications, panel closure and installations, bracket and stand off installations.

positions.title: Manufacturing Painter
positions.description:
Worked on robotic equipment that would stack, sort and palatalize corrugated cardboard. prior to paint and assembly and touch up after assembly prior to ship.

Responsibilities included the following:
Chip welding burs,
Clean parts with chemical solvents,
Disassemble and reassemble motor units and other assemblies,
Back up painter when painter was absent,
Touch up parts and machines prior to shipping
Control inventory of paint booth,
Move heavy parts with crane or forklift as required.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed website WSU school of nursing using XTML coding and Cascading Style Sheets.

honors.title: Harpoon Weapon System Test Stand and Drive Stand
honors.description: Volunteered to make emergency recovery plan for AGM 84 Harpoon Weapon System Test Stand and Drive Stand. Recognized by leadership for performance and delivery.
honors.issuer: Issued by Mindy Johnson, General Manager. · Sep 2013

honors.description: Awarded Employee of the month delivering high quality plans consistently and following up down stream to support may of the parts and assemblies as they are being built.

projects.title: LSCC business Intelligence
projects.description:
📊 Overview: In a pivotal move to revamp LSCC's operational landscape, I took the initiative to establish and lead a dedicated data science team from its inception. This group became the backbone behind the design, development, and deployment of an all-encompassing Business Intelligence suite tailored to LSCC's unique needs.

Key Achievements:

Founding a Data Science Team:

Recognizing the need for specialized expertise, I recruited, mentored, and led a data science team, fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration.

Under my leadership, the team played an instrumental role in the development and success of each BI tool rolled out.

Production Readiness Validation Tool:

Orchestrated the development of a tool that tracks production constraints in real-time, validating production readiness at pivotal junctures.

Enterprise-Standard Shipside Action Tracker:

Championed the creation of a scorecard system for shipside insights. Its efficacy led to its adoption as an enterprise standard, setting a benchmark for data-driven decision-making.

SQL Server & Data Pipeline Integration:

Pioneered the setup of a production-ready SQL server for optimal data management.

Architected a seamless data pipeline, enabling real-time data access and catalyzing improved business decisions.

Automated Data Management:

Leveraged cutting-edge technologies to automate the data pipeline, ensuring timely and accurate data feeds, which became crucial for enhanced analytics and strategic insights.

Impact:
The establishment of the data science team and the subsequent BI suite significantly bolstered LSCC's capabilities. The results were tangible: streamlined processes, validated production stages, and a pronounced shift toward data-centric decision-making.

projects.title: Kc46 Supplier Liason.
projects.description: Production support for Leonardo Aeronautica KC46 and 767F vertical stabilizer. Receive part, analyze and investigate for defects, process engineering as required, and rework structural components for flight control surfaces
